**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) covers only access cut-off (10.1), Deliverable delivery and refunds (10.2). Section 10.1 references "any agreed transition period" but creates no assistance right or duration. Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy duty and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist in the document, and Section 15 imposes only processing restrictions, no return or export duty. Searches for return/export/delete/machine-readable found no other responsive clause.
- **Target level:** fallback, as the shortest complete cure for a genuinely absent clause.
- **Operation:** one insert after 10.2 carrying all three fallback elements (expiry-or-termination trigger, at least 90 days' transition assistance, Customer Data export within 30 days), with no added survival, expense, or procedural tails.
